candidates.summary: msg of both bls12381 natives is neither bounded in the .gno wrapper nor sloped in the gas row, so a call hashing 64 MiB pays the same gas as one hashing 32 bytes
candidates.failure_scenario: A realm allocates one large []byte once (make of 16 MiB measured at +24 gas) and calls bls12381.FastAggregateVerify(oneKey, msg, sig) or FastAggregateVerifyExcluding(agg, nil, msg, sig) repeatedly. HashToG2 runs expand_message_xmd, which SHA-256s all of msg, and the dispatcher copies msg into Go first, yet the rows slope only on pubkeys (SlopeIdx 0) and excluded (SlopeIdx 1). Validators spend work growing linearly with len(msg) for a flat charge: per-call gas 2130789 at 32 B and 2130908 at 64 MiB, while native time grows 26.6x (Excluding 22.4x). This is the exact class adr/native_input_bounds.md forbids ('bounded in the .gno wrapper or sloped'), which the wrapper comment at bls12381.gno:35-36 and the ADR cite as satisfied. Fix: Slope2 on msg (param 1, param 2 for Excluding) at sha256.sum256's per-byte rate, or bound msg in the wrapper (Ethereum signing roots are 32 bytes).
candidates.verify_by: gno test -v on tests/solo-finder-2-msg-unmetered_test.gno: per-call gas (x5-x1)/4 identical at 32 B, 1 MiB, 16 MiB, 64 MiB; go test -bench BenchmarkMsgGrowth from tests/solo-finder-2-msg-unmetered_test.go: ns/op grows 1.6x, 7.8x, 26.6x over msg=32

candidates.summary: the bls12381 rows say 'regenerate with the rest of the table', but neither the calibrate harness nor gen_native_table.py knows them, so a regeneration drops both rows
candidates.failure_scenario: The reference-machine regeneration the row comments and the ADR require before deployment runs gnovm/cmd/calibrate (ibc_native_bench_test.go benches keccak256, modexp, bn254, cometbls, merkle) and gen_native_table.py (IBC specs list bn254, cometbls, no bls12381). The emitted table carries no crypto/bls12381 row, chargeNativeGas panics 'has no calibrated gas entry' on the first call, and the per-key price stays an M4 x2.3 hand-scale rather than a measured one. CI's gno test with a gas meter would catch the panic, so the cost is a recalibration that cannot produce these two rows without new bench code.
candidates.verify_by: grep -c bls gnovm/cmd/calibrate/ibc_native_bench_test.go gnovm/cmd/calibrate/gen_native_table.py at 0ee53fefc: expect 0 each; grep -n 'crypto/bn254\|crypto/cometbls' gen_native_table.py shows the IBC spec list at lines 217-225
candidates.evidence: grep -rln 'bls12381|bls12-381' gnovm/cmd/calibrate/ returned no file; gen_native_table.py IBC specs at 217-225 name bn254 and cometbls only
